name: ActaSeal
summary: For companies whose AI agents send money to customers (refunds, credits, payouts, payments): each one is checked against the company's rules before the money moves, and leaves a record anyone can check without trusting the company or ActaSeal.
deployment_model: runs in the customer's own infrastructure or cloud account

public_resources.name: offline verifier
public_resources.purpose: check a receipt or evidence pack with no ActaSeal account and no network call to ActaSeal

public_resources.name: actaseal-verify
public_resources.purpose: the offline verifier as a Python package, Apache License 2.0

public_resources.name: limits
public_resources.purpose: what the product does not do
